description: Add and remove tasks using JavaScript.
definition: A to-do list turns user input into items that can be managed.
rule: Create the item, set text, append it.
tip: Clear the input after adding the task.
exercise: Add a task and a remove button.
title: Build a JavaScript To-Do List: Add and Remove Tasks
shortTitle:
Type a task.
Add it to your list.
idea: An input becomes a new list item.
